quest.title: Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom
quest.description: ...Near the flower field of Millhaven, now left in disarray, you notice a woman sighing in frustration. A brief exchange reveals the cause of the chaos — a forest boar has been trampling the flowers...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000, Recipe: Millhaven's Morning Plate x1

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: *sigh* Not again... Why does this keep happening? The field's a mess...

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: At this rate, I won't be able to deliver the flowers on time. What am I supposed to tell my customers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Look at this. The whole field's wrecked... These flowers were coming in beautifully, and now they're ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: All because of that menace!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's inhuman!

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: I know, right? ...Well. Not human at all, actually. It's a forest boar.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: For some reason, it keeps coming down here lately, nibbling the flowers and then flopping around in the middle of the field.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: And it's slippery. The moment anyone hears it and heads over, it takes off. Just now it nearly barreled into an elderly man passing by...

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: It's outrageous. This fellow's a real boor, I tell you!

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Oh — wait... hold on. Aren't you the Honorary Knight? The hero who saved Mondstadt? Then please, I really need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright. I'll chase it off!

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: That's such a relief... I think it headed toward the valley.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: It's a clever beastie. You might have to lure it out with flowers... though, well, you can see what's left of mine...

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Maybe grab a few Windrest Flowers along the way and use them as bait. Would serve it right to get fooled for once!

talks.objective: Wait for the forest boar to appear (Wait until 08:00 the next day)
Chase off the forest boar ruining the flower field
Tell Leopoldine the forest boar is gone

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Oh — you're back? How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We chased it off!

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Ah, thank you so much. Here, this is for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Work deserves payment, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: Now I can finally get the flower field back in order. Let's just hope no more "inhuman" visitors show up again...

dialogues.speaker: Leopoldine
dialogues.text: *sigh* These poor flowers are completely ruined. Now I'll have to replant the whole patch... honestly...
